description: This file contains functions related to interacting with a database for storing and retrieving behavioral observation events within the BORIS project. It includes functions to load events into an in-memory SQLite database, create indexes for efficient querying, and handle both individual event loading and aggregated events processing.

methods.name: load_events_in_db( pj: dict, selected_subjects: list, selected_observations: list, selected_behaviors: list, time_interval: str = cfg.TIME_FULL_OBS, )
methods.description: Populates an in-memory SQLite database with events from selected observations, subjects, and behaviors, creating a table with event data, including indexing for efficient queries.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str,Optional[sqlite3.Connection]] load_aggregated_events_in_db( pj: dict, selected_subjects: list, selected_observations: list, selected_behaviors: list )
methods.description: Populates an in-memory SQLite database with aggregated behavioral events, performing additional processing such as merging point and state events into continuous intervals, and creating indexes for optimized access.
